DeviceManagementManagedDevices.Read.All.description: Intune: Alle Geräte lesen (Name, Status, Owner, Sync-Datum, Model, OS-Version)
DeviceManagementManagedDevices.Read.All.setupInstructions: Azure AD > App Registrations > [App] > API permissions > +Add permission > Microsoft Graph > Application permissions > DeviceManagementManagedDevices.Read.All

DeviceManagementManagedDevices.ReadWrite.description: Intune: Geräte schreiben (Sync triggern, wipe, retire, remote actions)
DeviceManagementManagedDevices.ReadWrite.setupInstructions: WARNUNG: Kritische Permission. Nur geben wenn absolut nötig.

DeviceManagementConfiguration.Read.All.description: Intune: Policies, Compliance Rules, Update Rings lesen
DeviceManagementConfiguration.Read.All.setupInstructions: Azure AD > App Registrations > [App] > API permissions > +Add permission > Microsoft Graph > Application permissions > DeviceManagementConfiguration.Read.All

Group.ReadWrite.All.description: Entra ID: Gruppen erstellen, lesen, aktualisieren, loeschen
Group.ReadWrite.All.setupInstructions: WARNUNG: Kritische Permission. Erlaubt Gruppenverwaltung. Azure AD > App Registrations > [App] > API permissions > +Add permission > Microsoft Graph > Application permissions > Group.ReadWrite.All

DeviceManagementConfiguration.ReadWrite..description: Intune: Policies erstellen, lesen, aktualisieren, loeschen (Settings Catalog, OMA-URI, EDR)
DeviceManagementConfiguration.ReadWrite..setupInstructions: WARNUNG: Kritische Permission. Erlaubt Policy-Verwaltung. Azure AD > App Registrations > [App] > API permissions > +Add permission > Microsoft Graph > Application permissions > DeviceManagementConfiguration.ReadWrite.All

DeviceManagementServiceConfig.ReadWrite..description: Intune: Defender Connector, Service-Konfiguration lesen und schreiben
DeviceManagementServiceConfig.ReadWrite..setupInstructions: WARNUNG: Kritische Permission. Azure AD > App Registrations > [App] > API permissions > +Add permission > Microsoft Graph > Application permissions > DeviceManagementServiceConfig.ReadWrite.All

SecurityEvent.Read.All.description: Microsoft Defender: Threats, Vulnerabilities, Alerts lesen
SecurityEvent.Read.All.setupInstructions: Setzt MDE (Microsoft Defender für Endpoint) voraus. Nur relevant wenn Threat-Management aktiv.

User.Read.All.description: Entra ID: Alle User-Profile lesen (displayName, UPN, signInActivity etc.)

AuditLog.Read.All.description: Entra ID: Sign-In-Logs und signInActivity Property auf User-Objekten lesen
AuditLog.Read.All.setupInstructions: Azure AD > App Registrations > [App] > API permissions > +Add permission > Microsoft Graph > Application permissions > AuditLog.Read.All. Erforderlich fuer signInActivity auf User-Objekten.
